description: This file contains extension methods for configuring dependency injection services related to the Conduit ASP.NET Core application. It includes methods to register MediatR, validators, automapper, security, JWT authentication, and logging services.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Contains static extension methods to register application services, JWT authentication, and logging configurations.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures dependency injection for MediatR, validators, AutoMapper, password hashing, JWT token generation, user context, and profile reading.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Sets up JWT authentication parameters including issuer, audience, signing credentials, and token validation settings.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog with console sink for logging and attaches it to the ILoggerFactory.
